lines.en: I cannot walk, my roots are in the ground
This is not walking, it is stone growing
Staying perfectly still is what I do
I have no legs, only a shell
The wind that would move me must go around
I keep watch over this ground
I try to shift and cannot

lines.zh: 石头在动，也只是光在动
lines.en: The stone seems to move, but it is only light

lines.zh: 我在这块地上，动也不动
lines.en: I am on this patch, unmoving

lines.zh: 你从我旁边走，我连侧身都不做
lines.en: You pass me by, I do not even lean aside

lines.zh: 所谓走动，是别人在我旁边走
lines.en: What walking there is, is others walking past me
I stand like something old
The shell is cut with patterns I cannot read

lines.zh: 我看不见你，可我知道你
lines.en: I do not see you, yet I know you
My shell is thick, it does not break
The air turns cold beside me
Nobody has come near in a long time
A layer of dust covers me

lines.zh: 我一直在等一个不该来的
lines.en: I keep waiting for something that should not come
You came close, I noticed
I look at you through this shell
How long have you stood here
This place is not for walking through
I do not move, and I watch
I do not like the light on you

lines.zh: 我上次说话，是很久以前
lines.en: The last time I spoke was very long ago

lines.zh: 你绕着我走，我一直在中间
lines.en: You circle me, and I stay at the center

lines.zh: 你的靴子上，有我这里的土
lines.en: There is soil from here on your boots
Not even a mark on the shell
That did not even ring
Something inside the shell shifted
It strikes me, and I watch it
My shell is far too thick
The air grew a little colder
It stepped back, hand numb
Not one of my roots has moved
That was not worth the effort
I am still standing in place

lines.zh: 你的东西放在地上就好
lines.en: Just leave it on the ground

lines.zh: 这层壳封着，什么都进不来
lines.en: This shell is sealed, nothing gets in

lines.zh: 你把东西举给我，我没有手
lines.en: You hold it out, and I have no hands

lines.zh: 这一带的东西都活不长
lines.en: Nothing here lives long
Put that back where it came from
I do not know what you are offering
Stand back, my shell starts to hum
Keep your hand out of the seams
Take it away, I have no need
You struck the shell and it did not move

lines.zh: 你退开的时候，手是麻的
lines.en: Your hand was numb when you pulled away
I have pinned this ground
Do not touch the seams, they are open
My shell has never dodged

lines.zh: 你撞上来的时候，空气响了
lines.en: The air rang when you struck
That put you back three steps
Touch again and the shell answers on its own

lines.zh: 我不是石头，可也差不多
lines.en: I am not stone, though close enough
I cannot even shift aside
Something like me wants no company
I have stood here many years

lines.zh: 你说的这些，我回答不了
lines.en: I cannot answer that

lines.zh: 离我近的东西，最后都会走
lines.en: Everything that comes close eventually leaves

lines.zh: 我没有体温，也没有耐心
lines.en: I have no warmth and little patience
You should be leaving here

lines.zh: 这地方只有一个位置，就是我的
lines.en: There is one place here, and it is mine
Standing this close, the shell grows hot
Say no more
I cannot take it, my hands will not lift

lines.zh: 东西落在我的壳下，就归这儿了
lines.en: What falls beneath my shell belongs here
I watch it without moving
It rests against my roots
Pick it up, I do not mind
This shell is too heavy

lines.zh: 它让我想起很久以前的东西
lines.en: It reminds me of something from long ago
Think before you take it

lines.zh: 这里的东西，都带着我的气味
lines.en: Everything here carries my scent
Better that it stays
Something is approaching
My shell is warming
It has entered my range

lines.zh: 我不需要转身，我四面都能看
lines.en: I need not turn, I see in all directions
This place is not yours

lines.zh: 我身上的纹路亮了一下
lines.en: The patterns on me brightened once
Listen, the air is ringing
It is still walking this way

lines.zh: 我抬起不了手，可我能射出去
lines.en: I cannot lift a hand, but I can still fire
My roots go very deep
The closer you get, the hotter the shell
There is no door in this shell
It stopped and is looking at me
There is a trace of rust in the air
One more step and I fire
I am locked on it, without moving

lines.zh: 我的壳上有道缝，正对它
lines.en: A seam on my shell is aimed at it

lines.zh: 它绕着走，我跟着转视线
lines.en: It circles, and my gaze follows
This one is not strong
I do not chase, I wait for it to come
The dust on the ground keeps moving
The light on me brightens and dims
It cannot enter my circle
My shell hums, very low
There is no second path through here
It is hiding behind that stone
Stone is no shield against it
It hesitated, good

lines.zh: 我再等一会儿，等它靠近
lines.en: I wait a little, for it to come closer
The shell is getting hotter
This area has gone quiet again
I have not gone dim
It will certainly come back
I have no hands, but the shell can strike
A beam fires from a seam
That sent it back two steps
A line of pattern flashes across the shell
The air cracked once
It was pushed away, and I did not move
It knows the weight of that shot
Something turns inside the shell
It is no match for me
I light up again
That one was half an inch off

lines.zh: 它贴着石头躲，我就打石头
lines.en: It hides by the stone, so I strike the stone
A little smoke leaks from the seam
A chunk of stone is sheared off
It withdrew, and I did not follow
It still cannot enter this stretch

lines.zh: 我身上的纹路又暗下去
lines.en: The patterns on me dim again
Quiet is the best result
It has gone around to that side
One more rise and that is enough

lines.zh: 这里本来就有一块石头
lines.en: There was always a stone here

lines.zh: 我立起来的时候，地动了一下
lines.en: The ground moved when I rose
The air dropped half a degree
Leaves have not yet fallen off my shell
The light in this area dimmed

lines.zh: 一根柱子，忽然不像柱子了
lines.en: A pillar suddenly stopped being a pillar
I grow up out of the soil, slowly
My patterns brightened once
Everything nearby drew back

lines.zh: 我落地时没有任何声音
lines.en: I landed without any sound

lines.zh: 这个地方，需要有人看着
lines.en: This place needs something to watch it

lines.zh: 我的根扎进去，土都硬了
lines.en: My roots went in and the soil hardened

lines.zh: 火烧在我壳上，只留下烟
lines.en: Fire on my shell leaves only smoke
I fell and my shell split a crater
Water rose and began to seep in

lines.zh: 炸得我壳上的纹路全乱了
lines.en: The blast scrambled every pattern on me
The arrow struck and glanced off

lines.zh: 那股劲儿钻进来，壳里在响
lines.en: That force got in, and the shell is ringing

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，这壳也不靠吃
lines.en: I do not eat, and this shell does not run on food

lines.zh: 雷落在壳上，我亮了一下
lines.en: Lightning hit the shell and I flashed

lines.zh: 这里没有可以扎根的地方
lines.en: There is nowhere here to sink roots
